name: particle-button
title: Particle Button
description: A button for async actions. Returning a promise makes the label crossfade to a spinner and a pending word, then to a drawn tick and success word with a burst of particles, or to a red shaking error.
use: A click starts an async save, publish or payment and the button should report its outcome in place.
avoid: Actions with no clear end: success and error states revert after a fixed time regardless.
a11y: Status words are announced politely and aria-busy is set while pending; reduced motion removes the burst and shake. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Three small pill buttons on black: a white filled Save changes, a dark outlined Publish post with a right arrow, and a grey Pay $49.00. While busy the icon becomes a spinner, success swaps in a drawn tick, and failure turns the whole button red with an alert circle.
behaves: A click shows the pending label while the promise runs and the button's width springs to fit each new word. On resolution the label blurs and slides to a tick and success word, with small chips bursting from the top edge, or the button shakes and stays red long enough to read.
customise: The idle label is children, with pending, success and error labels plus icons, durations and a particles flag as props; styling comes from the shared button variants.
weight: light: At most one short canvas particle burst and a few spring transitions per click.
